notes: NCD.LRI is an aggregate adult mortality cause
IHD is included in adult NCD.LRI mortality
Stroke is included in adult NCD.LRI mortality
COPD is included in adult NCD.LRI mortality
Lung cancer is included in adult NCD.LRI mortality
LRI is included in adult NCD.LRI mortality
Diabetes is included in adult NCD.LRI mortality
Dementia is included in adult NCD.LRI mortality
CV is an aggregate cardiovascular mortality cause
IHD is included in CV mortality
Stroke is included in CV mortality
Adult LRI can coexist with child LRI if age ranges do not overlap
Child LRI can coexist with adult LRI if age ranges do not overlap
